Definition: properly, white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire; hence (figuratively) noble (in rank)
BiblicalUsage: Chor is a noble, a freeborn man of rank, and the histories use it for the leaders who sign and seal and contend. Jezebel writes letters to the elders and nobles of Naboth's city, the preacher says blessed is the land whose king is the son of nobles, and Nehemiah contends with the nobles who take usury from their brothers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the nobles in these verses show that rank is no shield from sin, because the nobles can be the worst offenders. I hold that God judges the high and the low by the same law, and that is the comfort of the poor.
